data.name: Kiyanansh
data.gender_notes: Kiyanansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kiyanansh is derived from the Sanskrit language. Kiya means 'sky' or 'heaven', and Anansh means 'grace' or 'graceful'. This name signifies the presence of the divine and the blessings of the heavens. The name Kiyanansh carries the meaning “Sky or Heaven, God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kiyanansh usually hope their child will grow to embody sky or heaven, god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine grace and protection.
data.etymology: Kiyanansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sky or Heaven, God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiyanansh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
